import sys,random,ipaddress,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from gen_targets import plan
random.seed(5)
leases={}
for i in range(20):
 pl=random.choice([56,64]); p=f'2001:db8:{random.randrange(65536):x}:{random.randrange(256):02x}00::/{pl}'
 net=ipaddress.IPv6Network(p,strict=True)
 subs=sorted(random.sample(range(0 if pl==64 else 256),1 if pl==64 else random.randrange(1,5)))
 leases[f'L{i:02d}']={'id':f'L{i:02d}','prefix':p,'start':0,'end':10,'subnets':subs,'low_count':random.randrange(1,5),'network':net}
man,lookup,low=plan(leases,'seed')
# independent expected
exp=[]
for lid in sorted(leases):
 l=leases[lid]
 for sub in sorted(l['subnets']):
  base=int(l['network'].network_address)+(sub<<64)
  n64=str(ipaddress.IPv6Network((base,64)))
  can=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256((f'seed\n{lid}\n{n64}').encode()).digest()[:8],'big')|(1<<63)
  exp.append({'lease':lid,'probe':f'{sub}/c','target':str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base+can))})
  for k in range(1,l['low_count']+1):exp.append({'lease':lid,'probe':f'{sub}/i{k}','target':str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base+k))})
assert man==exp,(man[:3],exp[:3])
